description: Synonymously rewrite codons to eliminate restriction recognition sequences (DNA or RNA, IUPAC codes, each at most 64 characters) while preserving the protein; linear in the sequence length.

restriction_sites.description: Recognition sequences to eliminate (DNA or RNA, IUPAC codes allowed, each at most 64 characters; empty entries are skipped).

target_organism.description: Preset id or inline custom table.

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table number (default 1 = Standard). Synonymous codons are taken from this code's families, so the protein is preserved under it.

optimizedSequence.description: RNA-alphabet sequence with sites removed where possible.

errors.message: Coding sequence cannot be null or empty
At least one restriction site is required
Restriction site '…' contains a character that is not an IUPAC nucleotide code
A restriction site is N characters long; the longest supported is 64.
